test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which letter will be on the face opposite to the face showing 'A'? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45ffa57aa5c847e0697df1ae1a0cea4b8682acabd5ad041ccabb6db43c67418d.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ce4792ce78ab1fa48adc15a02ee15453d8b6234b888ea2264ee9acce898d11c.png] 

K and C is the opposite sides.

R and D is the opposite sides.

B and A is the opposite sides.

So, the face of 'B' is opposite to the face showing 'A'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
